name: Diviner-driven surface-temperature boundary
purpose: Score temperatures returned through the production surface callback against quality-filtered D03 GCP hold-out samples without gap filling.
configuration: Derived lola_surface.in receipt selecting diviner-map and the campaign-owned processed D03 table; eight MPI ranks; no inferred constants.
independent_reference: Frozen checkerboard hold-out D03 tbol rows and independent adjacent-quarter-hour interpolation in Python; missing native bins remain gaps.
units: temperature and residual K; planetocentric latitude/positive-east longitude degrees; local time hours
frame_time_convention: MOON_ME_DE421 body-fixed geometry, LSO particle state, SPICE TDB internally, archive UTC where supplied
deterministic_stochastic_controls: Random seed and MPI/OpenMP layout recorded; stochastic criteria use declared confidence intervals.
procedure: Verify I13; reproducibly process and hash all GCP products; initialize DIVINER_MAP; query the production callback at the linked SPICE epoch and eligible hold-out coordinates; independently interpolate only complete neighboring native time bins; retain row-level comparison artifacts.
acceptance_criteria: Processed QA READY and hashes exact; only GOOD hold-out rows; at least one comparison; every temperature finite and positive; RMSE <=15 K; no gap filling or assumed uncertainty.
expected_pass_result: The declared linked M2 capability is evaluated and every frozen criterion is met.
data_hashes: Recorded in run_manifest.json after package hash verification.
status_semantics: PASS means the full linked criterion ran and passed; FAIL means it ran and missed the criterion; ERROR is infrastructure/parser/corruption; SKIPPED means a prerequisite, capability, configuration, or authoritative input is unavailable.
